text:
maria: Quick non-work poll — if you could only smell ONE scent for the rest of your life, what would it be? Reply with one word or emoji.
aj: Fresh coffee ☕️
benji: Rain on pavement. the wet-asphalt thing. nostalgic.
taylor: Pine trees — camping vibes :evergreen_tree:
sam: Freshly cut grass. summer memories.
bot-coffee: bot-coffee: Today's roast smells like: Portuguese roast :coffee: (not voting, just chiming in)
maria: Bonus points for reasoning :smile:
aj: coffee because it wakes you up and literally everything smells better after a sip :sweat_smile:
benji: rain because it's calming and never gets old. also smells different in different cities.
taylor: pine because it's seasonal but clean and evergreen.
sam: grass because it actually takes me right back to backyard soccer.
aj: @maria obvious attempt to sway with enthusiasm? :wink:
maria: tally so far — coffee 1, rain 1, pine 1, grass 1. tie! more votes?
benji: also, coffee shops = ambient noise + pastry smell = combo win.
aj: +1 to that. coffee wins tie in my heart :heart_eyes:
maria: ok next tie-breaker: would you choose a scent that's comforting or energizing?
sam: comforting
benji: calming/comforting
taylor: energizing
aj: energizing
maria: good mix. love the variety. poll closed? :partyparrot:
bot-coffee: deploy-brew triggered :coffee_machine:
aj: thanks all — this weirdly made my afternoon better :relaxed:
benji: same here, feel less doomscroll-y :sweat_smile:
end.
